shadows.name: ambient-low
shadows.purpose: Low subtle depth for active overlays.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Standard action button for committing entries and copying text.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #0f766e; color: #ffffff; padding: 8px 16px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; border: none; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease-in-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #0b5f59; }

components.name: ID Pill
components.description: Unique record identifiers mapping trace details.
components.css: .ds-pill { font-family: monospace; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: #0b5f59; background: #eef5f2; border: 1px solid #d9e1dc; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 4px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }

narrative.overview: Field Learning Studio is designed as a professional analytical workspace for Monitoring, Evaluation, and Learning (MEL) practitioners. The visual environment mimics a clean, authoritative reporting ledger rather than a consumer web application. Space, boundaries, and typography are optimized for scanning dense programmatic findings, source logs, and evidence matrices without cognitive fatigue. The design prioritizes structured layout, visual hierarchy, and explicit content regions.
keyCharacteristics: Restrained color strategy: Primarily neutral palette with a teal accent (≤10% of surface) to direct focus.
Clear boundaries: Strict grid divisions, thin borders, and structured headers keep data compartmentalized.
High-contrast readability: Strict compliance with WCAG AA/AAA text legibility for institutional settings.
Explicit traceability: Visual linking of claims to their exact raw source logs.

rules.name: The Ledger Rule
rules.body: Every interface element must behave like a part of an official evaluation document. Visual decoration that does not contribute to hierarchy, scanning speed, or validation of claims is prohibited.

rules.name: The Restraint Rule
rules.body: Avoid flashy trends, decorative background grids, neon highlights, and dark mode by default. The tool must look at home in a ministerial department or a donor briefing room.

rules.name: The Accent Rarity Rule
rules.body: Muted Teal (#0f766e) must not cover more than 10% of any screen. Its strength lies in its scarcity; it should only call out focus areas and interactive endpoints.

rules.name: The Monospace Identifier Rule
rules.body: Any reference to a record ID, source ID, finding ID, or recommendation ID must use a monospaced font family, structured as a pill, to make its status as a reference marker distinct.

rules.name: The Shadow Ban Rule
rules.body: Do not pair a 1px solid border with a soft drop shadow on buttons, cards, or inputs. Choose either a solid 1px border at rest OR a flat background tint; never use shadows as decoration.

dos: Do check contrast ratios for secondary and status text to guarantee at least 4.5:1 against the canvas.
Do wrap display titles in text-wrap: balance to prevent awkward orphaned words.
Do restrict body line lengths to a readable width (max 75ch).
Do keep every ID pill linked to a source view or action.
donts: Don't look like a flashy AI startup landing page.
Don't use excessive animations or motion.
Don't make it look like a generic chatbot.
Don't use side-stripe borders (e.g., border-left-4) as accents on findings or recommendations cards.
Don't use gradient text under any circumstances.
Don't use card corners with border-radius larger than 8px.
